name: TwentyPad
description: Launch, swap, and claim fees for TwentyPad B20 tokens on Base.
examples: launch B20 called StreetCat ticker SCRATCH pair ETH
use twentypad to buy 0.001 ETH of TWENTY
use twentypad to check my TwentyPad fees
use twentypad to claim my ETH fees
setup: Install this skill on your Bankr agent.
Use a Bankr wallet on Base with a little ETH for gas.
Creator fees credit the wallet that submitted createLaunch.
